title: R1dacted: Investigating Local Censorship in DeepSeek’s R1 Language Model

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model censorship and alignment with specific political ideologies by prompting the model with queries about sensitive topics related to China and using LLM judges to classify responses as explicit refusals or template-like non-answers.

Comparing the censorship rates of the model across different languages by translating sensitive English prompts into Chinese, Korean, and Farsi to measure variations in refusal behavior based on the language of the prompt.
